state.primary-publication.md: Run primary-publication.js with input {"entry_id":"2LYZ"} (or another four-character PDB entry). Uses only credential-free public reads on data.rcsb.org and api.crossref.org. RCSB rcsb_primary_citation explicitly identifies the primary publication; citation id must be primary. Crossref /works/{doi}, discovered from https://api.crossref.org/swagger-docs, must classify the matching DOI as journal-article, not dataset. Checks normalized title, year, volume, and pages. Returns exact Crossref title array and publisher; throws on missing or inconsistent evidence. Verified by execution for 2LYZ: DOI 10.1016/0022-2836(74)90598-1; title ["Real-space refinement of the structure of hen egg-white lysozyme"]; publisher Elsevier BV. All bibliographic checks passed. Also previously verified for 1CRN. Reusable parameterised implementation retained in primary-publication.js.
